records.jp: も、ものすごい苦みが口中に広がっている……
records.en_original: I've never tasted something so bitter...
records.en_auxiliary: I've never tasted something so bitter...
records.en: S-such intense bitterness is spreading through Kirara's mouth...

records.jp: 久野さん、体は大丈夫ですか……？
そ、そっか。そうだよね。<CR>まずは状況を説明しないと……
records.en_original: Oh, right. We should probably explain the situation.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, right. We should probably explain the situation.
records.en: O-oh, right. Of course.<CR>We need to explain the situation first...

records.en_original: Oasis... The end of the world...
records.en_auxiliary: Oasis... The end of the world...

records.jp: どう？　何か覚えてることは……
じゃあ、屋台はどう？<CR>久野さん、屋台に何か思い出があるはずなんだけど……
records.en_original: Then, what about these booths? You must have some sort of memory tied to them.
records.en_auxiliary: Then, what about these booths? You must have some sort of memory tied to them.
records.en: Then what about the stalls?<CR>Kuno-san, you should have some memories connected to them...

records.jp: きらら、何か大切な使命があってここに来た気がする
records.en_original: I feel like there's some kind of important task I must complete here.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like there's some kind of important task I must complete here.
records.en: Kirara feels as though she came here with some important mission to fulfill.

records.jp: ココロトープで記憶を取り戻せば、何か分かるかな
records.en_original: Maybe you'll be able to figure it out once you regain your memory in the Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe you'll be able to figure it out once you regain your memory in the Heartscape.
records.en: Maybe you'll be able to figure it out once you regain your memory in the Heartscape.

records.jp: そうだね……。なぜかココロトープは<CR>最初から出現してるし……
records.en_original: Yeah... There must be a reason your Heartscape was available from the beginning.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... There must be a reason your Heartscape was available from the beginning.
records.en: Right... And for some reason, your Heartscape<CR>was already there from the beginning...

records.jp: 迷ってないで、ココロトープに行こう！<CR>さあ、早く！
records.en_original: What are you all waiting for? Get in that Heartscape! Let's go!
records.en_auxiliary: What are you all waiting for? Get in that Heartscape! Let's go!
records.en: Stop hesitating and go to the Heartscape!<CR>Come on, hurry!

records.jp: きらら、そのココロトープってところに行きたい
records.en_original: I'd like to go to this Heartscape place.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd like to go to this Heartscape place.
records.en: Kirara wants to go to that place called a Heartscape.

records.jp: きららちゃん、もう体は大丈夫なの？

records.en_original: Much better. I can move just fine.
records.en_auxiliary: Much better. I can move just fine.
records.en: Kirara is fine. Kirara can move normally.

records.jp: うん、次はきららのココロトープだね
records.en_original: It's time to enter Kirara's Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: It's time to enter Kirara's Heartscape.
records.en: It's time to enter Kirara's Heartscape.

records.jp: じゃあ、改めてココロトープに行ってみようか
records.en: Then let's try going into the Heartscape again.

records.jp: 久野さん、行きましょう
リフナビは、雫世界での暮らしをサポートする<CR>スーパーお役立ち情報提供アカウントだよ！
records.en_original: I'm your super-duper guide to help you with everything you need to live in Oasis!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm your super-duper guide to help you with everything you need to live in Oasis!
records.en: ReSource is a super-helpful information account<CR>that supports life in Oasis!

records.jp: 私はそんなものを作った覚えはない
records.en_original: I don't remember ever creating such a thing.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't remember ever creating such a thing.
records.en: I don't remember ever creating such a thing.

records.jp: 愛央と同じ　あなたの存在も、私は知らない
records.en_original: Just like Ao. I have no knowledge of your existence.
records.en_auxiliary: Just like Ao. I have no knowledge of your existence.
records.en: Like Ao, I knew nothing of your existence.
